how_to_run: Load this playbook as context for a planning session
CRITICAL: Before starting Phase 0, read the phase_summary field to understand all 16 phases. Do NOT begin execution until you can name every phase.
A single agent fills all roles — switch mental context per phase
Work through phases sequentially — each phase gate must pass before the next
For each task: read the title and description, complete the work, verify completion
At phase gates: verify all conditions are met, collect metrics_snapshot if present, then proceed

Context management: this playbook file may exceed your context window. Use the phase_summary field as a navigation index. When entering a new phase, re-read that phase's checklist from the JSON rather than relying on memory of earlier reads.
Final output: a domain-specific playbook JSON following output-schema.json
session_strategy: Phases 0-1: Share a session (scoping and research are tightly coupled)
Phases 2-3 (KB Architecture + Bootstrapping): Share a session — design then build
Phase 4 (Process Architecture): Fresh session with new eyes on structure
Phases 5-6 (Role + Task Engineering): Share a session — roles inform task writing
Phases 7-8 (Output Config + Metrics): Share a session
Phase 9 (JSON Assembly): Dedicated session — heaviest context load
Phase 10 (JSON Validation): Fresh session — validate with fresh eyes
Phases 11-12 (Gap Analysis + Stress Testing): Share a session — audit pair
Phase 13 (Contamination Testing): Fresh session — verify no creator artifacts leaked
Phase 14 (Final Review & Approval): Human review gate — break session here
cost_optimization: Use compilation blocks — only load what the phase needs
Respect excluded_context — don't re-load what was deliberately dropped
For large playbooks: break JSON Assembly into multiple sessions (assemble, then validate)
Audit phases benefit from fresh context — don't carry forward build-phase thinking

assess: What went well in the process
What should change in the playbook
Metrics: target vs actual for every defined metric
Quality assessment: were gates effective, were tasks clear, were roles right
Catalog any failure modes encountered during the run

failure_modes.symptom: KB architecture designed in Phase 2 but no directory, placeholders, or entries exist after creation completes
failure_modes.root_cause: No phase executes the KB blueprint — Phase 2 designs it, but building was out of scope
failure_modes.fix: Execute Phase 3 (KB Bootstrapping) to create directory tree, seed placeholders, harvest initial entries
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 3 gate verifies KB directory exists with populated entries before advancing

failure_modes.symptom: Cross-cutting concern appears in only 1-2 phases despite 3+ minimum requirement
failure_modes.root_cause: Weaving instruction is vague — 'must appear in 3+ phases' without specifying enforcement method
failure_modes.fix: Check each CCC's phases_applied array, add enforcement to additional phases until minimum_phases met
failure_modes.prevention: CCC objects have enforcement_method and phases_applied fields; Phase 10 validates count >= minimum_phases

failure_modes.symptom: Task title uses [Human] but owner field says 'human' — role validation fails
failure_modes.root_cause: Inconsistent bracket syntax between title and owner field during manual JSON assembly
failure_modes.fix: Normalize all owner fields to bracket syntax matching title: owner must be '[Role]' not 'Role' or 'role'
failure_modes.prevention: Validation script checks owner field matches [Role] in title exactly

failure_modes.symptom: KB layers defined as JSON array instead of named keys — agents cannot look up layers by name
failure_modes.root_cause: Entry schema says 'layers' but doesn't specify whether it's an array or object
failure_modes.fix: Restructure layers as named keys in the knowledge_base object, or as array of objects with required 'name' field
failure_modes.prevention: KB schema validation task explicitly checks layer structure format

failure_modes.symptom: Failure mode entries missing required fields (title or description) — FM references are broken
failure_modes.root_cause: FM entry schema not enforced during manual assembly
failure_modes.fix: Add all required fields to each FM entry: id, symptom, root_cause, fix, prevention, phase, severity, source
failure_modes.prevention: Validation script checks all 8 required FM fields, FM-ID pattern, and no duplicates

failure_modes.symptom: Metrics missing ID fields — cannot cross-reference from tasks or gates
failure_modes.root_cause: Metric schema did not require an ID field
failure_modes.fix: Assign sequential MET-NNN IDs to all metrics
failure_modes.prevention: Validation script checks metric ID uniqueness and MET-NNN format for v3+ playbooks

failure_modes.symptom: Cross-cutting concerns stored as plain strings — no enforcement metadata, no tracking of where they're applied
failure_modes.root_cause: CCC schema only required a description string, not structured enforcement data
failure_modes.fix: Convert each CCC string to object with id, title, description, enforcement_method, enforcement_rule, minimum_phases, phases_applied
failure_modes.prevention: Validation script checks CCC object structure, phases_applied count >= minimum_phases

failure_modes.symptom: Phase N+1 context_load references file not in Phase N's next_phase_context — handoff chain gap
failure_modes.root_cause: Handoff blocks assembled manually without systematic chain verification
failure_modes.fix: Trace full handoff chain and add missing files to next_phase_context or remove from context_load
failure_modes.prevention: Validation script checks handoff chain consistency (check 16); dry-run protocol traces chains for all scenarios

failure_modes.symptom: Gate handoff skill_validation field references wrong phase's skill — 10 mismatches found
failure_modes.root_cause: Gates were copied between phases and skill field not updated
failure_modes.fix: Audit every gate's skill_validation against the phase it hands off TO, not the current phase
failure_modes.prevention: Stress testing scenario traces skill activation chain; validation script checks skill_activation consistency

failure_modes.symptom: KB layer directories missing from context_load — 12 directories not loadable
failure_modes.root_cause: KB directories referenced in phase_kb_mapping but not in compilation block context_load
failure_modes.fix: Add all referenced KB directories to relevant phase context_load arrays
failure_modes.prevention: Validation script cross-checks phase_kb_mapping against context_load; stress test verifies KB access per phase

failure_modes.symptom: All 13+ context_load files at priority 5 — budget system cannot make intelligent loading decisions
failure_modes.root_cause: Priorities assigned uniformly without considering which files are core vs reference-only
failure_modes.fix: Differentiate priorities: 5 for core inputs, 4 for section-specific, 3 for reference, 1-2 for persistent tracking files
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 9 and 10 split into assembly (heavy context) and validation (light context); priorities differentiated per file importance

failure_modes.symptom: Pilot testing is a mental walkthrough, not real execution — misses runtime issues
failure_modes.root_cause: Real pilot requires multiple sessions outside the creation context, which is impractical
failure_modes.fix: Use structured dry-run protocol with scenario matrix, phase-by-phase walkthrough, handoff chain trace
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 14 gate accepts either structured dry-run (2+ scenarios) OR real pilot; dry-run protocol is systematic and documented

failure_modes.symptom: Task description says 'build X' without method, specs, or verification — task is unexecutable
failure_modes.root_cause: Task granularity standard not enforced during task writing
failure_modes.fix: Add WHAT/HOW/SPECS/VERIFY structure to all non-obvious task descriptions
failure_modes.prevention: Auditor review in Phase 6 uses binary checklist: does each description answer what, how, and how to verify?

failure_modes.symptom: 4-layer bridged KB designed for a domain that could use a flat folder — massive over-engineering
failure_modes.root_cause: No complexity assessment before KB design; defaults to maximum complexity
failure_modes.fix: Re-evaluate using Phase 2 Task 1 complexity questions; switch to flat if warranted
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 0 complexity classifier sets knowledge dimension; Phase 2 gate guardrail_checks flag mismatches

failure_modes.symptom: Playbook scope covers all variants (effects + instruments + synthesizers) instead of common case with conditionals
failure_modes.root_cause: Scope definition didn't distinguish primary path from variant paths
failure_modes.fix: Define primary scope (common case), mark variant-specific tasks as conditional
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 0 scope task explicitly requires primary/variant distinction; complexity classifier informs scope breadth

failure_modes.symptom: Metrics defined with targets but never measured during execution — metrics are decorative
failure_modes.root_cause: No measurement task in gates, no tracking file, no collection mechanism
failure_modes.fix: Add metrics_snapshot to gate handoff blocks; initialize metrics-tracker.md in Phase 0
failure_modes.prevention: metrics_snapshot.collect lists metric IDs to record at each gate; metrics-tracker.md persists across sessions

failure_modes.symptom: failure_modes array empty after first execution — no guidance when things go wrong
failure_modes.root_cause: Cold start problem: v1.0 playbooks have no execution history to draw failure modes from
failure_modes.fix: Seed failure_modes with entries from first execution; update failure_modes_relevant in affected phases
failure_modes.prevention: v4 creator ships with 26 seeded FMs from first execution; Phase 15 catalogs new FMs from each run

failure_modes.symptom: Phase N requires Phase M's output but Phase M requires Phase N's — circular dependency
failure_modes.root_cause: Dependency map not validated for cycles during process architecture
failure_modes.fix: Break the cycle by reordering phases or splitting the shared dependency into a prerequisite phase
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 4 dependency mapping task requires DAG proof (no circular dependencies); validated in architecture review

failure_modes.symptom: project-state.json referenced in tasks and gate handoffs but never created by any task
failure_modes.root_cause: File referenced before a creation task was written for it
failure_modes.fix: Add initialization task or remove all references
failure_modes.prevention: Artifact provenance validation (check 17) catches files in context_load not produced by any prior phase

failure_modes.symptom: Context compaction at session boundary loses critical details — decisions and rationale silently dropped
failure_modes.root_cause: Session strategy doesn't account for LLM context window compaction behavior
failure_modes.fix: Ensure all critical decisions are persisted in decisions-ledger.md before session breaks
failure_modes.prevention: Session strategy aligns breaks to phase gates where decisions-ledger is updated; context_preservation rules enforce persistence

failure_modes.symptom: success_criteria contradicts gate_conditions — agent works toward targets that the gate doesn't verify, or gate checks things not in success criteria
failure_modes.root_cause: success_criteria and gate_conditions authored independently without cross-checking
failure_modes.fix: Review each success_criteria entry against gate_conditions — every criterion should map to at least one gate condition
failure_modes.prevention: Cross-validation check 19 warns when success_criteria count and gate_conditions count diverge significantly (ratio < 0.3 or > 3.0)

failure_modes.symptom: tools_available too restrictive — agent cannot perform required tasks because a needed capability is not listed
failure_modes.root_cause: tools_available authored without checking what capabilities each task actually requires
failure_modes.fix: Walk through each task description and verify the tools_available list covers all required capabilities
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 10 validation audits tools_available against task descriptions — flag tasks that imply capabilities not in the list

failure_modes.symptom: tools_available too permissive — lists capabilities not needed by the phase, defeating role bleed prevention
failure_modes.root_cause: tools_available copied from another phase without trimming to actual needs
failure_modes.fix: Remove capabilities not required by any task in the phase
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 12 stress testing verifies each tools_available entry is actually used by at least one task in the phase

failure_modes.symptom: behavioral_profile mismatch — phase has adversarial stance but tasks require constructive building, or supportive stance on an audit phase
failure_modes.root_cause: behavioral_profile authored based on role name rather than actual phase activities
failure_modes.fix: Review behavioral_profile against phase purpose and task types — stance must match the work being done
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 10 validation cross-checks behavioral_profile.stance against role_mindset role name (Auditor phases should not be supportive, Builder phases should not be adversarial)

failure_modes.symptom: Orphaned success_criteria — criteria exist but phase has no gate_conditions to verify them, so success is declared without checking
failure_modes.root_cause: success_criteria added to compilation block but gate task not updated to match
failure_modes.fix: Add corresponding gate_conditions for each success_criteria entry, or remove criteria that are not verifiable
failure_modes.prevention: Cross-validation check 19 catches phases where success_criteria exists but gate_conditions is empty or missing

failure_modes.symptom: Executing agent completes early phases (0-3) in detail but produces only summaries or skips later phases entirely. Final output is a skeleton, not an executable playbook.
failure_modes.root_cause: Playbook file exceeds the agent's practical context window. Agent reads only the first few phases and synthesizes the rest from imagination. No mechanism forces the agent to acknowledge or re-read later phases before execution.
failure_modes.fix: Use the phase_summary field as a navigation index. Re-read each phase's checklist from the JSON before executing it. The Phase 0 inventory task ensures all phases are acknowledged before work begins.
failure_modes.prevention: Phase 0 gate requires phase inventory acknowledgment (all 16 phases listed in decisions-ledger.md). Context management guidance in usage_instructions directs re-reading per phase.

router.description: The playbook creator is a sequential process — the router is trivial. Start at Phase 0 and proceed through each phase in order.
decision_tree: New playbook commission → Start at Phase 0
Resume interrupted run → Check artifact-manifest.md for latest phase, resume there
Post-run improvement → Go directly to Phase 12
router.default: Start at Phase 0 with a commission brief

context_preservation.decisions_ledger: decisions-ledger.md — append-only, one paragraph per phase gate: phase number, key decisions, constraints discovered, rejected alternatives with brief rationale
context_preservation.artifact_manifest: artifact-manifest.md — running index of every file: path, producing phase, status (active|superseded|archived), one-line summary
context_preservation.metrics_tracker: metrics-tracker.md — running log of metric values collected at phase gates. Columns: Metric ID | Phase | Value | Target | Date
rules: All three files are initialized in Phase 0 and updated at relevant gates
decisions-ledger.md and artifact-manifest.md are always included in context_load — exempt from token optimization cuts
metrics-tracker.md is included in context_load only for phases whose gates collect metrics
At session breaks, verify all three files are saved and current before ending
If context compaction occurs mid-session, these files serve as ground truth for recovering state
